title: UwUPlugin
description: UwUPlugin adds customizable suffixes to messages from selected players, making your server's chat cozier and more personalized.
body:
**UwUPlugin** is a lightweight and customizable plugin that adds a touch of cuteness to your server's chat.

**Features:**
✨ Automatic suffix addition
Selected players automatically get a specified suffix at the end of every chat message. Default is :3, but you can change it to anything!

⚙️ **Flexible configuration via config.yml**

List of players affected by the plugin

Customizable suffix (can be :3, owo, UwU, >_<, or any other text)

Plugin messages (fully customizable to match your server's style)

🎯 **Who it works for**
The suffix is only added to players you specify in the configuration. Everyone else chats normally.
